subject: AI-generated workout routines (built, device-tested)
description: DONE 2026-06-04. Built: ✨ Suggest a Routine on the Routines page — Gemini drafts a routine from the exercise library, existing routines, and 8-week per-exercise stats (sessions, best set, latest difficulty, pain flags), targeting under-trained muscle groups inferred from exercise names. Optional free-text hint; Bodyweight only (default) / Equipment OK toggle; ~15-17 min time budget (hint can override). Draft reviewed before save (remove rows, 🎬 how-to per exercise); save uses pick-or-create so new exercises join the library. Exercises last rated Easy are forbidden in the prompt AND stripped by a code backstop (with a note). Shipped alongside: ExerciseDefinition.VideoUrl + migration (editable in /exercises, 🎬 in workout runner/draft, YouTube-search fallback) and routine rename (name is display-only; sessions key off the Guid). Not built (deliberate): proactive nudge from the daily check-in — manual button only.
